items.title: Three questions to ask about AI inference in Amazon EKS, and how Amazon CloudWatch answers them
items.summary: GPUs are expensive and scarce. On a cluster shared by several AI teams, an idle GPU costs you twice: once on the bill, and again as capacity a team is waiting for. Three questions follow: which workload holds each GPU, how well it uses it, and which workloads are affected when one GPU goes bad. […]
items.creator: Jean Velez Torres

items.title: Well-Architected Foundations Accelerator and ongoing assessment
items.summary: Learn how the AWS Well-Architected Foundations Accelerator and the open-source Well-Architected Foundations Assessment help you find gaps in your cloud foundations, implement AWS Well-Architected Cloud Foundations guidance in your own accounts, and track your progress over time.
